title: Prince Harry speaks about social media – level 3
paragraphs: During a visit to the European Parliament in Brussels, Prince Harry delivered a powerful speech condemning social media platforms for exposing children to online harassment, bullying, and mental health risks.

The Duke of Sussex described short-form content and platform algorithms as brainwashing on an extraordinary scale and advocated for stricter digital regulation. At the same time, he pointed out audience members who were scrolling on their phones during his address, and urged them to consider the real-world harm inflicted on vulnerable youth. Harry backed the proposed EU Kids Act, which aims to hold tech platforms accountable rather than placing the burden entirely on parents. Accompanied by Meghan Markle who attended briefly following recent difficult personal news the couple met with lawmakers and supported grieving families who lost children to online harm.
EU leaders praised their advocacy, and promised to introduce strict age verification, restrict addictive features, and fine non-compliant platforms.
